perfiles_functions.name: es_admin
perfiles_functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.es_admin()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
BEGIN
  RETURN EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.perfiles
    WHERE id = auth.uid() AND rol = 'Admin'
  );
END;
$function$

perfiles_functions.name: handle_new_user
perfiles_functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handle_new_user()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO public.perfiles (id, email, nombre, rol, estado)
  VALUES (
    new.id, 
    new.email, 
    new.raw_user_meta_data->>'nombre',
    COALESCE(new.raw_user_meta_data->>'rol', 'Operativo'),
    'activo'
  );
  RETURN new;
END;
$function$
